hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git push" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[git-push-guard] git push is never auto-allowed. The user must explicitly request a push or run /ship-it." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git branch.*-D|git branch.*--delete.*--force|git branch.*--force.*--delete" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[branch-protection] git branch -D (force delete) is blocked. Use git branch -d (safe delete) or ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git reset" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[reset-guard] git reset is blocked. This can destroy uncommitted work. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git checkout -- |git checkout \\.|git restore [^-]|git restore \\.\\." 2>/dev/null; then echo "[restore-guard] git checkout -- and git restore discard uncommitted changes permanently. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git clean" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[clean-guard] git clean deletes untracked files permanently. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit" 2>/dev/null && echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "\-\-amend" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[amend-guard] git commit --amend is blocked. Create a new commit instead." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git stash drop|git stash clear" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[stash-guard] git stash drop/clear permanently deletes stashed work. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git worktree remove.*--force|git worktree remove.*-f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[worktree-guard] git worktree remove --force is blocked. Use without --force or ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "find .*-execdir|find .*-exec" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[find-exec-guard] find -exec/-execdir is blocked. Use the Read tool to inspect files, or pipe find into grep (find ... | grep ...) -- both are pre-approved." && exit 2; fi'
